verdict.rationale: First-party docs publish 256 GiB of HBM3 per MI325X (2TB across an 8-GPU node), which is ample to hold a 70B-class quantized model on a single GPU. ROCm docs also provide inference recipes for vLLM and SGLang, making single-node inference practical. Missing for 10: a published memory-bandwidth figure (none appears in the pack), and independent or hands-on corroboration of actually running 70B-class models.
